pages.title: Concentrated Bone Chunk
pages.text: Four bone blocks, four bones and one mutant skeleton body part craft into a single Concentrated Bone Chunk at a crafting table. Right-click a Mutant Skeleton Servant with it to empower the servant, up to five times.
75, Attack 3, Speed 0.27.$(br)It cannot take a new weapon, but you can still give it armour to harden its defence; you may also give it $(item)Bones$() and $(item)Bone Blocks$() to heal it.
